scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules shared/node_modules client/dist server/dist shared/dist client/tsconfig.app.tsbuildinfo client/tsconfig.node.tsbuildinfo shared/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo shared/tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo
scripts.build: npm run build -w @turnier-hub/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.prod:prepare: npm run db:generate -w server && npm run build
scripts.prod: npm run prod:prepare && npm run prod:start
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run db:generate && npm run build && node desktop/prepare.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run db:generate && npm run build && node desktop/prepare.mjs darwin && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run db:generate && npm run build && node desktop/prepare.mjs darwin && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --mac --arm64
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run db:generate && npm run build && node desktop/prepare.mjs win32 && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --dir
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run db:generate && npm run build && node desktop/prepare.mjs win32 && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --win --x64
